content:
**Bloody Frank's** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

Bloody Frank's is a Blood Eagle lair and restaurant built on top of several pre-War buildings including the Berkeley Springs Spa and Amelia Espresso. There is a spa area in the back room, with a couple of bodies floating in some toxic water.

The location itself is made of shacks and wooden walkways built above the spa and outlying buildings. Frank had an interest in the culinary arts and left cooking tips and recipes on notes and terminals scattered around the premises. A non-working elevator and a back stairway connect to the second floor of the spa.

- Brahmin noodle soup - Note, in the main cooking area, on a table next to several ingredients.
- Frank's Fine Radstag Dedemption - Note, on a table in a camper on the north side of the catwalk.
- Hunter's headcheese - Note, on a shelf in the northern kitchen area.
- Larry's Lowcountry Mirelurk Boil - Note, on a table next to a bunk bed near the highest point of the camp.
- Dishwasher Steve's note - Note, on a metal shelf on the roof of the spa building near a bathtub and scattered dishes.
- Stealth Boy - On a blue metal barrel on the roof of the spa building near a bathtub and scattered dishes.

Bloody Frank's appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

 Sometime between the release of *Wastelanders* and *Steel Dawn*, the map marker for Bloody's Frank was mistakenly changed to "Berkeley Springs." This was corrected with the release of patch 1.5.2.32 alongside the *Locked & Loaded* update. Patch 27 changed the name back to "Berkeley Springs".
